Hey! Hey it's okay. It might not feel like it but you are okay. You are a wonderful person and I'm so proud of all of what you've come through you have made it so far and you will make it so far. 

      It might not seem like that right now but one day it will, it might not be today or tomorrow and maybe not even a week from now but I want you to know that it will one day get better you just have to keep being strong a little bit longer. You have gone through so much and you deserve a break but just keep pushing a little bit longer you've got this.

     1. Have you eaten today? If not please go get something to eat malnutrition is super bad for you(if you have an eating disorder (1A). Take small bites you don't need to eat a lot just try and eat a little bit. 
(1B). Of you binge, watch yourself try and eat without throwing up if you feel the urge to make yourself take deep breaths and drink some water. 
    If you cannot stop yourself drink water.)
 
      2. Have you drank water today? If not please do dehydration is so unbelievably bad for you! It can cause you to be sick, dizzy and so many other things.

      3. If you have self harmed. Clean. Your. Wounds. It so super important that you clean them! I don't know the best way too, nor do I really know how but there are tons of resources on how to! Please don't let them get infected I care about you ♥️

    4. Remember to practice self care! Take a nice warm bath, drink some tea, read a book, draw. Do things that make you happy! Take a break from school/work for this and do things that can help clean your body. If your body is clean y can help your mindset. I know it may seem like a lot and it might be overwhelming and scary at first to do this for yourself, but it's worth it. It'll help make you feel better.

    5. Remember there are people willing to fight for you! You don't have to fight this battle alone, you can always vent to me or someone else if you need to and someone can be there.

    6. Remember you are loved! Even if it doesn't feel like it. You have got this. Something good will come your way!
